sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B VRAM Requirements: 13GB to 54GB, Explained
sources.snippet: The hybrid-architecture wildcard Qwen3.6-27B was a hybrid model: only 16 of its 65 layers used a traditional KV cache, while 48 used a fixed recurrent state. The result was roughly four times less KV memory than a dense model of the same size — which is a large part of why a 27B felt like a 24 GB card model rather than a 48 GB one.
